title: Planned Weekly Frequency for an Insured Plan of Care Authorization Extension
content:
**Central Authorization Unit — Insured Plan of Care.** The weekly frequency planned for the coming authorization period is the plan of care's:

1. where the plan has a **booked** Appointment Series, it is that series' visits per week;
2. where it has none but an **active** series, it is the active series' visits per week;
3. otherwise it is the payer program's weekly visit maximum.

| Payer program | Weekly visit maximum (third line) |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Plan of Care | 3 |
| Commercial High-Deductible Plan of Care | 3 |
| Commercial POS Plan of Care | 3 |
| Commercial HMO Plan of Care | 3 |
| Medicare Part B Plan of Care | 3 |
| Medicare Advantage Plan of Care | 3 |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan of Care | 2 |

**Hypothetical illustrations.** A plan with a booked series at 2 visits per week and an active series at 3 uses 2, the booked series coming first. A plan with only an active series at 3 visits per week uses 3. A Medicaid Managed Care plan with no booked or active series uses 2. Over a 41-day period, 2 visits per week comes to 2 times 41 divided by 7, 11.714…, which rounds up to 12 visits.
